title: Seat two parties at the tables with the right number of chairs
instruction: seat the parties: put the red marker on the table with 4 chairs and the blue marker on the table with 2 chairs
context: Restaurant hosts (O*NET 35-9031.00) seat each party at a table that fits it, which means counting the chairs around each table on the floor. Here the four tables have 2, 3, 4 and 5 chairs, so the robot has to count rather than pick the nearest or the biggest table.
setup: Positions are measured on the table from the midpoint between the two arm bases: forward is away from the arms, left and right as seen from behind the arms. (1) Tables: four wooden blocks, fixed, each 12 x 12 cm and 3 cm tall, centred 20 cm forward and 40 cm forward, at 13 cm left and 13 cm right. (2) Chairs: grey blocks, fixed, 3 x 3 cm and 4 cm tall, each 1 cm out from a table's edge, centred on that side or 3 cm either side of its middle when a side has two. Far-left table: 2 chairs (far side, left side). Far-right table: 3 chairs (far, left and right sides). Near-left table: 5 chairs (2 on the near side, 2 on the left side, 1 on the right side). Near-right table: 4 chairs (2 on the near side, 1 each on the left and right sides). (3) Markers: a red and a blue 5 cm cube, 50 g each, loose, centred 7 cm forward at 6 cm right (red) and 6 cm left (blue). Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Scored once, after the episode ends. A marker is on a table if its centre is over that table's top and its bottom is within 1 cm of the top, still. 1.0: the red marker is on the near-right table (4 chairs) and the blue marker on the far-left table (2 chairs). 0.0 otherwise. There is no partial credit: a marker put on a random table would be right one time in four, so a half score would reward guessing.
reset_notes: Put the markers back on their marked spots in front of the arms. The tables and chairs are fixed (tape or putty).
fidelity: Calibrated YAM station replica in Isaac Lab-Arena (Isaac Sim). Tables and chairs are fixed rigid blocks (a scale model of a dining floor); the markers are rigid cubes of the stated size and mass. Lighting and cameras follow the station calibration.
